title: AiRouter Log Entry
description: Schema for a single line in the AiRouter JSONL request/response log (requests.jsonl). Each line is one JSON object conforming to this schema.

requestTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (with timezone offset) of when the request arrived at the router.

responseTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (with timezone offset) of when the last byte of the response was received from the upstream server.

durationMs.description: Elapsed time in milliseconds between request arrival and last response byte (responseTimestamp − requestTimestamp).

model.description: The model name extracted from the request body.

matchedRule.description: The regex pattern of the routing rule that matched this request.

targetUrl.description: Full URL the request was forwarded to (baseUrl + /v1/messages).

statusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the upstream server.

requestSizeBytes.description: Size of the request body in bytes (UTF-8 encoded).

responseSizeBytes.description: Size of the response body in bytes (UTF-8 encoded). For SSE streams this is the total accumulated size.

requestHeaders.description: All HTTP request headers. Authorization and x-api-key values are replaced with "[redacted]".

responseHeaders.description: All HTTP response headers returned by the upstream server (message headers + content headers).

requestBody.description: Full text of the request body sent to the upstream (after any model substitution).

responseBody.description: Full text of the response body received from the upstream. For SSE responses this contains the concatenated raw event stream.
